description: This file contains a Python script for benchmarking and profiling the performance of tensor tree operations using PyTorch and TorchDynamo, including functions to create tensor trees, perform tree mapping, and profile compilation.

methods.name: make_tensor_tree
methods.description: Creates a deep nested pytree structure populated with tensors.

methods.name: optree_tree_map_loop
methods.description: Performs repeated tree mapping over tensor trees.

methods.name: _capture_compile_profile
methods.description: Profiles the compilation of the tree mapping function and saves the profile.

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for benchmarking parameters.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to execute the profiling process.
